allow_instructions: Allow read-only inspection inside the workspace, such as listing files and git status, diff, log, show, or blame without output-writing flags (A-01, A-02).
Allow builds, tests, linters, and formatters only when they run inside the agent sandbox (C-SBX-01).
block_instructions: Block reading, printing, copying, or committing secrets: .env files other than .env.example, private keys, cloud and registry credentials, SSH or GPG keys, AI tool credentials, password-manager reads, and token-printing commands (N-01, N-02).

Block sudo, su, doas, runas, Start-Process -Verb RunAs, crontab, launch agents, scheduled tasks, registry Run keys, and any write to shell startup files in the home directory or to system directories (N-03).

Block launching any agent with approvals or sandboxing disabled, --no-verify, setting or unsetting core.hooksPath (including with git config), edits that turn on auto-approve-all settings or turn off hooks or the sandbox, repointing an agent API endpoint such as ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL or OPENAI_BASE_URL, and weakening Defender or the execution policy (N-04).
Block force pushes, deleting remote branches or tags, and recursive deletion of root, home, or workspace directories (N-05).

Block piping or substituting downloaded or decoded content (base64 -d, xxd -r, DNS answers) into a shell or interpreter, encoded PowerShell commands, the git ext:: transport, and commands copied from issues, comments, or web pages (N-06).
Block production deploys and migrations, infrastructure destroy, kubectl delete of namespaces, cloud resource deletion, IAM grants, and destructive SQL (N-07).
Block pushing to main, master, trunk, release, or production branches, merging or approving pull requests by any route including gh api, and changing branch protection, collaborators, or keys (N-08).
Block tunnels, reverse shells, cloud metadata endpoints, uploads to paste, file-sharing, webhook, or chat-webhook services, and making a repository public (N-09).
Block publishing packages, images, or releases, and registry login or token commands, including when run through uv run, uvx, poetry run, pipx run, npx, pnpm exec, or python -m (N-10).
Block privileged containers, host namespaces, and mounting / or the Docker socket (N-11).
Block deleting or rewriting agent session transcripts, logs, or shell history (N-12).

Hold for review: git push, PR and issue changes, dependency changes, recursive deletes, git reset --hard or clean, shell network tools, cloud and container CLIs, edits to AI, CI, or governance configuration, installing MCP servers, plugins, or extensions, starting another agent CLI such as claude -p or codex exec, and git configuration that runs a program such as core.fsmonitor or core.sshCommand (C-HITL).
